# B-Europe

> > B-Europe is SNCB International's platform for booking European train travel including Eurostar, TGV INOUI, ICE, and OUIGO services across Europe.

B-Europe operates both consumer and corporate booking portals, offering international rail tickets with features like invoice payment, Greenpoints loyalty program, and VAT recovery for business travelers. The platform connects Belgium with major European destinations through partnerships with leading train operators.

## Key Topics

- SNCB International
- Eurostar
- TGV INOUI

- OUIGO

## Booking Platforms

- [SNCB-NMBS International | Train travel in Europe](https://travel.acc.b-europe.com/): Homepage for booking European train tickets via Eurostar, TGV, ICE & OUIGO
- [Book train tickets in Europe and pay by invoice. Tickets for Eurostar, TGV INOUI, ICE & IC](https://corporaterail.b-europe.com/en): Corporate booking portal with invoice payment and Greenpoints loyalty program
- [Book train tickets in Europe and pay by invoice. Tickets for Eurostar, TGV INOUI, ICE & IC](https://corporaterail.b-europe.com/): Corporate rail booking service with monthly invoicing and VAT recovery
